palettes.pure: Spirit-light sounds: clean bells, organ and sine tones in open fifths and major thirds. For healing, cleansing, the player's own spirit powers, and the sanctuary. They stand out against the corruption.
palettes.corrupted: Sounds of things gone wrong: detuned and inharmonic tones (FM ratio of about 1.41), tritones and minor seconds, tremolo wobble, bitcrush, and long echoes. For enemies, corruption, curses and the darker zones.
palettes.neutral: General game sounds with no palette; usable anywhere, but tuned dark.

sanctuary.name: The Veil Haven
sanctuary.description: Safe hub. Calm and warm; uses the pure palette (organ fifths, clean bells).

hollow-wood.name: The Hollow Wood
hollow-wood.description: Dead spirit forest of bone-white trees: dry wind, creaking, whispers, hollow wood.

weeping-marsh.name: The Weeping Marsh
weeping-marsh.description: Flooded, corrupted wetland: slow drips, gloopy bubbles, heavy sodden low drones.

ashen-citadel.name: The Ashen Citadel
ashen-citadel.description: Ruined stone city of ash: cavernous echo, distant tolling bells, grinding stone, cold wind.

crystal-depths.name: The Crystal Depths
crystal-depths.description: Caverns of resonant spirit crystal: glassy pings, shimmering hum, long echoes; mostly pure palette.

rotted-heart.name: The Rotted Heart
rotted-heart.description: The source of the corruption: heartbeat, huge dissonant drone, bitcrushed glitches, dread.

theme_fit.core: Designed for or well suited to an eerie, corrupted spirit realm.
theme_fit.usable: Generic; fine to use, optionally re-pitched or paired with a corrupted variant.
theme_fit.off-theme: Arcade, sci-fi or modern flavour (guns, lasers, countdowns...). Avoid in this setting unless it is a deliberate contrast.

loops: Sounds with a `loop` value are ambience loops. They are rendered to wrap seamlessly (the faded tail is overlapped onto the head), so play them with looping enabled and no extra crossfade. `duration_seconds` is the loop length.
